rules.title: Rent Control Ballot Question
rules.requirement: A ballot proposal that would have limited annual rent increases for residences across Massachusetts was struck down by the state's Supreme Judicial Court and cannot go forward.

coverage.summary: Residences statewide, with exemptions including units operated solely for religious purposes.

rules.exemptions: Units operated solely for religious purposes and other unspecified exemptions.
rules.citation: Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court ballot question challenge
rules.quoted_span: The state’s Supreme Judicial Court ruled a ballot question seeking to bring rent control back to Massachusetts cannot go forward this November, because it includes a religious exemption.
